add_contact.label: Add Contact
add_contact.description: Add a new contact to your Google Contacts.

create_contact.label: Create Contact
create_contact.description: Create a new contact in the connected Google account.

emails.label: Email Addresses
emails.description: Array of email address strings, for example ["ada@example.com"]. A single address still has to be wrapped in an array.

phoneNumbers.label: Phone Numbers
phoneNumbers.description: Array of phone number strings, for example ["+1 555 0100"]. A single number still has to be wrapped in an array.

biography.label: Notes
biography.description: Free-text notes stored on the contact biography.

update_contact_fields.label: Update Contact Fields
update_contact_fields.description: Update only the supplied fields on an existing contact.

resourceName.label: Resource Name
resourceName.description: Opaque contact resource name such as people/c12345. Resolve it with List Contacts or Search Contacts.

emails.label: Email Addresses
emails.description: Array of email address strings, for example ["ada@example.com"]. Replaces every email address stored on the contact. Leaving it empty keeps the stored addresses; it does not clear them, because an untouched list and an emptied one cannot be told apart. Use Clear Email Addresses to remove them.

clearEmails.label: Clear Email Addresses
clearEmails.description: Remove every email address from the contact, including the last one. This is the only way to clear them. Cannot be combined with a non-empty Email Addresses list.

phoneNumbers.label: Phone Numbers
phoneNumbers.description: Array of phone number strings, for example ["+1 555 0100"]. Replaces every phone number stored on the contact. Leaving it empty keeps the stored numbers; it does not clear them, because an untouched list and an emptied one cannot be told apart. Use Clear Phone Numbers to remove them.

clearPhoneNumbers.label: Clear Phone Numbers
clearPhoneNumbers.description: Remove every phone number from the contact, including the last one. This is the only way to clear them. Cannot be combined with a non-empty Phone Numbers list.

get_contact.label: Get Contact
get_contact.description: Read a single contact by its resource name.

resourceName.label: Resource Name
resourceName.description: Opaque contact resource name such as people/c12345. Resolve it with List Contacts or Search Contacts.

update_contact_photo.label: Update Contact Photo
update_contact_photo.description: Set the photo of an existing contact from base64 image bytes.

resourceName.label: Resource Name
resourceName.description: Opaque contact resource name such as people/c12345. Resolve it with List Contacts or Search Contacts.

photoBytes.label: Photo Bytes
photoBytes.description: Base64-encoded JPEG, PNG or WebP image. A data URL prefix is accepted and stripped.

delete_contact_photo.label: Delete Contact Photo
delete_contact_photo.description: Remove the photo of an existing contact.

resourceName.label: Resource Name
resourceName.description: Opaque contact resource name such as people/c12345. Resolve it with List Contacts or Search Contacts.

update_contact_group.label: Update Contact Group
update_contact_group.description: Rename an existing user-created contact group.

resourceName.label: Resource Name
resourceName.description: Opaque contact group resource name such as contactGroups/abc123. Resolve it with List Contact Groups.
